basis.citation: Tsai et al., Chem Res Toxicol 2024, doi:10.1021/acs.chemrestox.4c00193 (PMC11691792)
basis.quote: Gene Expression Assays: Following chemical exposure for 24 hrs, the wells were completely aspirated and 10 uL/well of 2x lysis buffer ... was added

basis.citation: Zhang J, Ubas AA, de Borja R, Svensson V, ... Goodarzi H, Yu J. Tahoe-100M ... bioRxiv 2025.02.20.639398v2; formal record Cell 2026, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2026.08.035
basis.quote: we cultured spheroids consisting of a mixture of cell lines in suspension and subjected each spheroid to individual treatments, including DMSO vehicle controls. After 24 hours of drug treatment, spheroids were dissociated, fixed, and profiled using the Parse GigaLab kit
basis.figure_quote: Figure 1A legend: Each well receives a drug perturbation, and after 24h, tumors are dissociated into single cells
basis.note: the quoted sentences are the authors' own text in the v2 preprint of the same study; the Cell version is the formal record and is cited for the record. The atlas itself carries no time field, so no obs column is written.

vehicle_reproducibility.statistic: mean Pearson r of the well's raw-count vector (author-filtered genes) against every other DMSO vehicle control well, all 16 plates pooled
vehicle_reproducibility.op: exclude DMSO vehicle-control well if mean r < 0.85

evidence.citation: Tsai H-H, Ford LC, Burnett SD, Dickey AN, Wright FA, Chiu WA, Rusyn I. Informing Hazard Identification and Risk Characterization of Environmental Chemicals ... Chem Res Toxicol 2024. doi:10.1021/acs.chemrestox.4c00193 (PMID 39046974; GSE262419)
evidence.quote: Outliers in vehicle control samples were identified and excluded using a mean correlation threshold of <0.85
evidence.paper_quote: chemical effects were evaluated by comparing them to the plate-specific DMSO controls ... Outliers in vehicle control samples were identified and excluded using a mean correlation threshold of <0.85 ... a total of 4,379 samples (96% of 4,558 samples) and 11,039 genes remained
evidence.extension_policy: the study applies this floor to vehicle controls only; applying it to treated wells would be a response-correlated filter (a strong responder genuinely sits further from vehicle), so treated wells are flagged, never excluded, and the count is reported

blank_separation_floor.derivation: threshold = median + 3 · 1.4826 · MAD over the 32 technical Blank wells (no cells, same plates and same sequencing run); a real cell library must detect materially more genes than a no-cell well

evidence.citation: technical-blank control distribution of GSE262419, derived in this audit; 3-MAD band from Iglewicz B, Hoaglin DC. How to Detect and Handle Outliers. ASQC Quality Press, 1993: modified z-score M = 0.6745·(x − median)/MAD with |M| > 3.5 as the flag (equivalently |x − median| > 3·1.4826·MAD)
evidence.why_not_the_paper: the study names no detection floor per well; the blank wells are the only same-run no-cell reference

roles.treated_compound: Solvent == DMSO and Chemical_name not in {VEH, ET-1}
roles.control_media: Chemical_name == Media (is not a vehicle control)
roles.technical_blank: Chemical_name == Blank (no cells; never a control)
roles.positive_control_et1: Chemical_name == ET-1 at 0.01 uM (peptide positive control, not a small-molecule treatment)

control_rule.text: a treated temp_env well is matched only to DMSO vehicle wells on the same physical plate; Media is not a vehicle control, Blank is not a control
